therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Opioid receptor agonism via transmucosal delivery
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Summary of Pain Intensity Differences (SPID) at 30 minutes

subgroup_findings: Neuropathic pain subpopulation showed significant benefit at 15, 30, 45, and 60 minutes with larger effect sizes than overall population
results.dose_information: Small soluble film placed against mucosal membrane, dissolves within 30 minutes
